articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring natively fused vision, audio, and text reasoning in a single model architecture rather than stitched-together modules. The model supports a 1M-token context window with significantly improved long-range coherence, and benchmarks show major gains in multi-step mathematical and scientific reasoning tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra topped SWE-Bench Verified and the new AgentCoder benchmark, autonomously resolving over 70% of real-world GitHub issues end-to-end. The model introduces improved tool-use planning and self-verification loops that drastically reduce hallucinated fixes, signaling a step change in AI-assisted software engineering.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure's third-generation humanoid robot has entered volume deployment at BMW's Spartanburg facility, performing bin-picking, parts inspection, and inter-station transport tasks alongside human workers. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for flexible task switching without manual reprogramming, a milestone for general-purpose humanoid deployment in manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased Optimus Gen 3 performing unscripted household chores including laundry folding, dishwasher loading, and navigating cluttered rooms in a live streamed demonstration. The robot uses an end-to-end transformer policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned with teleoperation data, though experts caution that reliability in unstructured homes remains a significant engineering challenge.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework for Enterprise AI Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new open-source framework that lets enterprises define domain-specific safety and compliance rules as constitutional principles, which are then enforced at inference time through lightweight classifier heads. The approach reduces harmful or off-policy outputs by over 90% in enterprise RAG settings while adding less than 5% latency overhead, making it practical for regulated industries like healthcare and finance.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has started high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process, several months ahead of its original roadmap, with backside power delivery and gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. Early yields are reportedly above expectations, and the node is slated to power next-generation AI accelerators from Nvidia, Apple, and AMD shipping in late 2026.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving repeated rounds of fault-tolerant quantum error correction on logical qubits with below-threshold error rates on their latest trapped-ion system. The team executed over 100,000 consecutive logical CNOT gates with a logical error rate of 1e-6, a critical milestone toward building practical, scalable quantum computers.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric with Real-Time Terrain Adaptation via Foundation Model
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed a major software update for the electric Atlas platform that integrates a vision-language-action foundation model for real-time terrain assessment and locomotion planning. The system enables the humanoid to traverse previously unseen obstacles including rubble, mud, and steep inclines without pre-mapped paths, representing a convergence of large model inference and dynamic legged locomotion control.
